_doc: M2/E1 ground model parameters. 'source' says where the value comes from: census = the session's client class var (E0 dump), fitted = this analysis. spread_pct = (max-min)/mean over per-trial fits, pooled across the conditions where the parameter applies.

movescale.source: observed MOVE-TRACE msc (constant in every E1 command)
movescale.formula: multiplies speed, sprintspeed, crouch speed, lowSpeed, lowAcceleration, acceleration, sprintAcceleration

speed.source: census speed; fitted terminal walk speed / msc

sprintspeed.source: census sprintspeed; fitted terminal sprint speed / msc
sprintspeed.formula: cap = sprintspeed*msc while the sprint flag is set

crouch_speed.source: fitted: observed crouch maxspeed / msc (no census key read)

lowSpeed.formula: if held and s < cap: s = min(cap, s + a*dt) with a chosen from the pre-move speed s: lowAcceleration*msc if s < lowSpeed*msc; else acceleration*msc if not sprinting or s + sprintAcceleration*msc*dt < speed*msc; else sprintAcceleration*msc

lowAcceleration.source: census lowAcceleration; fitted pooled rate / msc
lowAcceleration.formula: if held and s < cap: s = min(cap, s + a*dt) with a chosen from the pre-move speed s: lowAcceleration*msc if s < lowSpeed*msc; else acceleration*msc if not sprinting or s + sprintAcceleration*msc*dt < speed*msc; else sprintAcceleration*msc

acceleration.source: census acceleration; fitted pooled rate / msc
acceleration.formula: if held and s < cap: s = min(cap, s + a*dt) with a chosen from the pre-move speed s: lowAcceleration*msc if s < lowSpeed*msc; else acceleration*msc if not sprinting or s + sprintAcceleration*msc*dt < speed*msc; else sprintAcceleration*msc

sprintAcceleration.source: census sprintAcceleration of THIS session (102; the T0 smoke census had 100); fitted pooled rate / msc
sprintAcceleration.formula: if held and s < cap: s = min(cap, s + a*dt) with a chosen from the pre-move speed s: lowAcceleration*msc if s < lowSpeed*msc; else acceleration*msc if not sprinting or s + sprintAcceleration*msc*dt < speed*msc; else sprintAcceleration*msc

deceleration.source: census deceleration; fitted pooled constant rate
deceleration.formula: if no move input: s = max(0, s - deceleration*dt)  (NOT scaled by movescale)

sprintDeceleration.source: census only; indistinguishable from deceleration here (both 1250; sprint stop fitted with the same rate)
sprintDeceleration.formula: if no move input: s = max(0, s - deceleration*dt)  (NOT scaled by movescale)

crouch_deceleration.source: fitted (crouch trials; no crouch census key was read)
crouch_deceleration.formula: while ducked with no move input: s = max(0, s - crouch_deceleration*dt) (not scaled by movescale)

stop_snap_speed.source: assumed Source WalkMove value (speed < 1 -> 0); data bracket it
stop_snap_speed.formula: after decel: if s < stop_snap_speed: s = 0

speedScaleBack.source: census; back terminal speed equals walk
speedScaleBack.formula: cap *= speedScaleBack when moving back (1 here)

speedScaleSide.source: census; side terminal speed equals walk

direction.source: fitted (heading = wishdir; diagonal speed = walk speed; turn keeps speed)
direction.formula: v = s * wishdir; wishdir = normalize(fwd*forward(yaw) + side*right(yaw)) (horizontal; instant redirect)

yaw_rate_turn_key.source: fitted from HSD yaw (+right console turn); a cl_yawspeed-type client setting, not movement physics

sprintStartDelay.source: census only; no effect on the speed curve was found
sprintStartDelay.formula: not used by the speed model (sprint band starts when s >= speed*msc; see GROUND-MODEL.md)

sprintStartDuration.source: census only; no effect on the speed curve was found

sprintStartFastDuration.source: census only; no effect on the speed curve was found

sprintEndDuration.source: census only; not exercised (sprint and forward were released together)
